step1_analysis.description: A lumped-element RLC circuit modeling an on-chip digital interconnect. It uses parallel RL branches to capture frequency-dependent resistance and inductance (such as skin effect and proximity effects) and a capacitor to model parasitic capacitance to ground.

paper_reference.title: High-Frequency Characterization of On-Chip Digital Interconnects

bandwidth.description: -3dB cutoff frequency of the interconnect model

sky130_expected.calculation: f_3dB ≈ 1 / (2 * π * sqrt(L_eq * C)) where L_eq is the parallel combination of L1 and L2.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Assuming typical on-chip interconnect parasitics (L_eq ~ 0.3nH, C ~ 100fF), the resonance/cutoff frequency falls in the tens of GHz range.

delay.description: Propagation delay from input to output (50% to 50% voltage level)

sky130_expected.reasoning: For short to medium on-chip interconnects, the time of flight and RC delay combined are typically in the picosecond range.

rise_time.description: 20% to 80% rise time at the output

sky130_expected.reasoning: Output rise time is limited by the input driver's rise time (assumed 20ps) and the low-pass filtering effect of the interconnect.

overshoot.description: Maximum voltage at the output during a step response

sky130_expected.calculation: Depends on the damping factor ζ = (R_eq / 2) * sqrt(C / L_eq)
sky130_expected.reasoning: If the interconnect is underdamped (low resistance, high inductance), the voltage can overshoot the 1.8V supply slightly.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure bandwidth, propagation delay, rise time, and overshoot of the interconnect model.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Interconnect Model Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

* Parameterized component values for the interconnect model
.param r1_val=50 r2_val=100 l1_val=1n l2_val=0.5n c1_val=100f

* DUT (Interconnect Model)
R1 IN N1 {r1_val}
L1 N1 VOUT {l1_val}
R2 IN N2 {r2_val}
L2 N2 VOUT {l2_val}
C1 VOUT GND {c1_val}

* Stimulus Sources
* AC source for bandwidth measurement, Pulse source for transient step response
VIN IN 0 DC 0 AC 1 PULSE(0 1.8 100p 20p 20p 500p 1n)

.control
  * AC Analysis
  ac dec 100 1Meg 100G
  let gain_db = vdb(VOUT)
  meas ac bandwidth when gain_db=-3 fall=1
  
  * Transient Analysis
  tran 1p 2n
  meas tran delay trig v(IN) val=0.9 rise=1 targ v(VOUT) val=0.9 rise=1
  meas tran rise_time trig v(VOUT) val=0.36 rise=1 targ v(VOUT) val=1.44 rise=1
  meas tran overshoot max v(VOUT)
  
  print bandwidth delay rise_time overshoot
  quit
.endc

.end
